T_tot_def: T_tot = dT_cmblens + dT_tsz + dT_cib per band (kSZ not included)

projection.coords: simulation HEALPix (theta, phi) of the HalfDome lightcone; NOT Galactic (l, b)
projection.rows: row 0 is theta = 0 (the simulation north pole); theta increases downwards
projection.columns: phi increases to the right from 0 at the left edge (the mirror image of the usual astronomical longitude-increases-left convention)
projection.pixel_centres: theta_i = (i + 0.5) pi / H, phi_j = (j + 0.5) 2 pi / W

display.note: JPEG colour images for viewing only (not for values). _dk = dark-centred diverging variant for overlays. tSZ display shows |dT|.

value_maps.format: PNG, 16-bit grayscale, non-interlaced (samples big-endian as in every PNG; rows use the standard adaptive filters 0-4)
value_maps.encode: u = round((clip(v, vmin, vmax) - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * 65535)
value_maps.clip: vmin, vmax = the 0.05 and 99.95 area-weighted percentiles of the map; clip_frac = sky-area fraction outside [vmin, vmax]
value_maps.pixel_value: PROVISIONAL (v1-derived): the v1 8-bit value of the sharp l <= 3000 field (nearest NSIDE-1024 pixel at each 4096x2048 grid centre, Lanczos-downsampled to 1024x512, ~21 arcmin), decoded with a half-level bias correction and duplicated 2x2; no smoothing, not a pixel area average
value_maps.units: muK, thermodynamic temperature, beam-convolved (2 arcmin FWHM); monopole kept
value_maps.stats: mean_uK, median_uK, sigma_uK (std about the mean) and rms_uK (about zero) are area-weighted over the STORED map: use sigma_uK for loudness weights. tSZ and CIB have a large monopole (the median is the empty-sky level), so |v - median_uK|/sigma_uK is quiet where the sky is empty. sigma_field_uK: see sigma_field.
value_maps.sigma_field: sigma_field_uK = sqrt(sum_{l>=1} (2l+1) C_l W_l^2 / 4 pi) from cls_cache.npz with the v1 sharp l <= 3000 cut (the provisional maps have no alms); for reference only
value_maps.shared_files: tSZ entries share two files (+y and -y orientation) and differ only in vmin/vmax; decode them like any other entry.
value_maps.v1_clipping: v1_clip_frac = fraction of v1's 4096x2048 grid pixels (unweighted, np.percentile) clipped when v1 built its 8-bit value map: 0.005 for the symmetric maps (|v| above the 99.5th percentile of |v|), 0.015 for the CIB (below the 1st or above the 99.5th percentile). saturated_code_frac_after_downsampling = area-weighted fraction of the 1024x512 v1 pixels whose 8-bit code is still at a limit (sym: 0, 1 or 255; CIB: 0 or 255) after v1's 4x Lanczos downsampling, which averages most clipped pixels with unclipped neighbours; it understates the clipping, use v1_clip_frac
